research_chat_launches_started_check.name: research_chat_launches_started_check
research_chat_launches_started_check.value: not ("app"."research_chat_launches"."state" in ('running', 'answer_pending', 'answered', 'answer_reappend')) or ("app"."research_chat_launches"."investigation_id" is not null and "app"."research_chat_launches"."controller_task_id" is not null)

research_chat_launches_source_mode_inves.name: research_chat_launches_source_mode_investigation_check
research_chat_launches_source_mode_inves.value: "app"."research_chat_launches"."source_mode" is null or "app"."research_chat_launches"."investigation_id" is not null

research_evidence_supported_check.name: research_evidence_supported_check
research_evidence_supported_check.value: "app"."research_evidence"."knowledge_status" <> 'supported' or ("app"."research_evidence"."scope" is not null and "app"."research_evidence"."basis" is not null and "app"."research_evidence"."evidence_version" is not null)

research_llm_calls_closed_check.name: research_llm_calls_closed_check
research_llm_calls_closed_check.value: ("app"."research_llm_calls"."status" = 'reserved') = ("app"."research_llm_calls"."closed_at" is null) and ("app"."research_llm_calls"."closed_at" is null) = ("app"."research_llm_calls"."charged_tokens" is null)

research_llm_calls_tokens_check.name: research_llm_calls_tokens_check
research_llm_calls_tokens_check.value: "app"."research_llm_calls"."reserved_tokens" > 0 and "app"."research_llm_calls"."counted_input_tokens" >= 0 and "app"."research_llm_calls"."attempt" >= 1 and ("app"."research_llm_calls"."charged_tokens" is null or "app"."research_llm_calls"."charged_tokens" >= 0)

research_llm_transcripts_binding_check.name: research_llm_transcripts_binding_check
research_llm_transcripts_binding_check.value: "app"."research_llm_transcripts"."investigation_id" is not null or "app"."research_llm_transcripts"."self_check_run_id" is not null

research_llm_transcripts_ledger_check.name: research_llm_transcripts_ledger_check
research_llm_transcripts_ledger_check.value: ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."llm_call_id" is null or ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."llm_call_id" = "app"."research_llm_transcripts"."call_id" and "app"."research_llm_transcripts"."investigation_id" is not null)) and ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."llm_call_id" is null) = ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."task_id" is null) and ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."task_id" is null) = ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."attempt" is null)

research_llm_transcripts_closed_check.name: research_llm_transcripts_closed_check
research_llm_transcripts_closed_check.value: ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."outcome" is null) = ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."closed_at" is null) and ("app"."research_llm_transcripts"."response" is null or "app"."research_llm_transcripts"."outcome" is not null)
